title: SMP Templates - Smoother Vanilla
description: Make a vanilla FabricMC server with some optimization tweaks. No extra content mods.
body:
![Basic description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de765bfef684b2aab6151a7abc3202522503811a.png)
---
### **The SMP Template series**

This series was made to create a structured packs for small server owners. It should be used to find inspiration or to use it as a base for SMPs.

### **General goal of this pack**

This pack aims to provide a pure vanilla experience but also optimize networking, chunk loading and performance in general.

### **What this pack does**

- General optimization
- Fabric loader to keep redstone and mechanics pure vanilla

### **What this pack is NOT adding**

- New content
- New biomes
- Gameplay changes

**WARNING**
This pack was not made by an experienced modder but just a casual player. It is not meant to be played by thousands of players or used for some commercial use.

## **Mod list**

- **Lithium:** basic entity and mechanics optimization.
- **FerriteCore:** memory usage optimization
- **Krypton**: improved networking
- **Noisium:** improved noise terrain generation
- **CCME:** better chunk gen and loading
- **ModernFix:** general impovements
- **ScalableLux:** light engine improvements
- **Spark:** performance monitoring and reports
- **ServerCore:** server tweaks and monitoring
- **Very many players:** high playercounts handling
- **Alternate current:** redstone optimization
- **Chunky:** pre generation tool
- **Clumps:** XP orbs lag reducer
- **Get it together, drops!:** Dropped items lag reducer
---
### **Credits**

Huge thanks to **SkulkerCraft** and the [Essentially Optimized modpack](https://modrinth.com/project/sTicmJba). SMP Templates - Smoother vanilla is greatly inspired by it. With my pack, I just wanted to present FabricMC server-sided modding in a different way.
